rules: Count independent physical subjects, not files or style variants, when judging external shape priors.
Record source provenance and license; do not transfer third-party mesh geometry without an explicit compatible-use decision.
Use only reviewed, sufficiently covered point-cloud regions for bounded, smooth body adjustments. Do not force sparse upper or lower regions to match noisy points.
Preserve the low upper rim unless direct edge evidence supports a change; compare the intentional exposed high flange against the original video.
Treat improvement against the same source point cloud as an iteration metric, not independent proof of clearance or fit.
Review exported meshes and original-photo overlays together; reject torn openings, thin side-hole edges, disconnected parts, self-intersections, and unintended interference.
reviewRequirements: input source hashes and coordinate transform
point-cloud coverage by region and trusted adjustment interval
maximum vertex movement and preserved opening evidence
watertightness, components, boundary and non-manifold edges, self-intersection and local thickness
original-photo overlays from front, side, rear and upper views
slicer preview with material and machine profile
releaseRule: A concept mesh or slicer-importable STL is not a printable, wearable product. Manufacturing approval requires the operator's independent geometry, slicer and physical fit sign-off.
